defect.proposed_fix: Keep the good_law / Binding-SCOTUS treatment call, but delete or qualify 'No negative treatment' with a note that proposed negative-event edges exist and require treatment audit.

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30 and the scope note says the media ride-along Fourth Amendment rule and qualified-immunity holding remain good law.

However, the same lake treatment record has 30 proposed edges labeled questioned, abrogated, superseded_by_statute, criticized, or overruled, and the negative/top-cited derivation lanes are audit_needed.
Because those edges are proposed and field_iii is only mentioned, they do not prove Wilson is no longer good law, but they do defeat the page's categorical 'No negative treatment' phrasing.
residual_risks: The disclosed record does not include full text of the citing treatment cases, so the actual effect of each proposed edge cannot be resolved from this packet alone.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Replace 'No negative treatment' with 'Lake marks Wilson good law as of 2026-06-30; proposed negative-treatment edges are pending audit.'
